title: Ponding instability.
officialText: For roofs with a slope less than ¼ inch per foot [(1.19 degrees (0.0208 rad)], the design calculations shall include verification of adequate stiffness to preclude progressive deflection in accordance with Section 8.4 of ASCE 7.
